provenance.cleanupNotes: The generated background was removed using the Moxie-specific low-frequency RGB contrast cleanup (Gaussian sigma38px; alpha fade contrast21–42); raw source retained separately.

review.reviewNotes: Ten full-body Moxie poses in row-major order. Adult human face and anatomy, pale skin, lavender eyes, gold-tied high ponytail, purple/silver uniform and high-tops remain consistent. Distinct composed celebration: measured fist pumps and overhead pose, arms opened, chest gesture, nod and wave, relaxed finish. No object or ball is drawn. Background cleanup reviewed in packed atlas over a light and court-colored ground.
